What each question is mending.
QGapWhat has to appear in your answer
1, 2B3-21 RAS is the G proteinGTP replaces GDP; the mutation destroys GTPase activity; RAS stays GTP-bound and active without growth factor
3B3-22 p53 identity · B3-24 the three rolesp53 is a transcription factor; arrest the cycle, repair DNA, trigger apoptosis, as a set
4, 9B3-23 one locus, two allelesone allele for gain of function (dominant), both alleles for loss of function (recessive)
4B3-28 myeloid against lymphoidmyeloid gives erythrocytes, neutrophils, monocytes, platelets
5, 6(b), 9B3-25 accumulationcancer is multi-step; unchecked divisions let the next mutation accumulate in one cell lineage
5, 9B3-27 contact inhibition against anchorage dependenceboth named, and not as synonyms
6(a)B3-26 selection in a tumourvariation, selective advantage, and the objection that a population is at organism level
7B3-29 totipotent against pluripotentthe words extra-embryonic membranes, on the right side of the distinction
8decay testyour own structure-function-location handle, written as definition plus figure-referenced example

Question 9 is cumulative and reaches back to Book 1 for the sickle cell protein chain and to Cluster 2 for non-disjunction. Telomerase is cut throughout, because it is not in the 9477 learning outcomes; where a real scheme awarded it, the point is removed and the removal is stated.
